name: validation-kickoff
title: Validation kickoff
purpose: When the foundation is settled, start the next step: put the decision to begin validating in front of the founder (M-12). An automation over the validation package, so it waits until the foundation package it needs is complete.

propose.question: The foundation is settled. Start validating the solution now: write the solution record and plan the first problem interviews?
options: Not yet: keep working the foundation

unlocks.activity: Draft the solution record and the interview plan

automations.note: Proposes a decision rather than writing records: the founder decides whether validation starts.

note: Turn it on with "kits": ["validation-kickoff"] in the venture's naive.config.json. The framework's trigger runner (interface/orchestration/triggers.mjs) runs it; this kit holds no code.
